name: sign-play-dots
title: Sign: play (dots)
description: A sign for "play", drawn as dots.

"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { Sign, type SignProps } from "@/components/ui/sign"
import type { SignShape } from "@/lib/0db/sign-shapes"

const shape: SignShape = {
  "word": "play",
  "line": [
    [
      [
        "M",
        5,
        5
      ],
      [
        "L",
        5.36,
        4.68
      ],
      [
        "L",
        5.79,
        4.45
      ],
      [
        "L",
        6.26,
        4.34
      ],
      [
        "L",
        6.74,
        4.34
      ],
      [
        "L",
        7.21,
        4.45
      ],
      [
        "L",
        7.64,
        4.68
      ],
      [
        "L",
        8,
        5
      ]
    ]
  ]
}

function SignPlayDots(props: Omit<SignProps, "shape" | "variant">) {
  return <Sign shape={shape} variant="dots" {...props} />
}

export { SignPlayDots, shape }
